description_en: Retrieves resource usage statistics for jobs
description_zh: 获取作业资源使用统计
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-job-resource-usage --db-cluster-id am-uf6g8w25jacm70000 --start-time 2023-02-04T03:45:00Z --end-time 2023-03-17T16:00:00Z --spark-app-name example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeJobResourceUsage

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为正整数。默认值为**1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
- 30
- 50
- 100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
- 30
- 50
- 100

默认值：30
